result: The team settled on a fish. Sofia proposed it and split the lines: Hana drew the start and nose, Sofia took the top line, Omar the belly, and Jack the tail. When Omar's belly fell behind, Sofia offered, "Want me to take the stretch near the tail end so we meet in the middle?" Omar kept the belly and asked her to check the pale upper fin instead. At the junction, Sofia's bridge "didn't fit, the spot's too crowded," so she held off. Omar bridged the upper fin into the body, and Hana cleared a stray line above the junction. Jack closed the notch between the fins. Then everyone went hands off. When the push came, 137 of 157 fell, and every player said it was a fish.
